newsitem.title: UK: Europe raw cotton markets see some buying.
newsitem.headline: Europe raw cotton markets see some buying.

text.p: European raw cotton markets were again quiet but some spinners bought selected new crop styles with Spanish cotton sold to Portuguese mills at attractive prices.
Some business also was mentioned in African Franc Zone descriptions for shipment after year's end whilst enquiry for Central Asian styles centred on medium qualities for Oct/Nov.
A wide disparity between buyer and seller price ideas restricted new business.
